whyProblematic: Jails morphing can overwrite DOM mutations inside owned component markup.
correctAlternative: Represent changes in state and directives, or isolate external DOM with html-static.
migrationApproach: Move text, classes, conditions, and attributes into directives; wrap third-party islands in html-static.

whyProblematic: Components become hard for AI systems and humans to reason about.
correctAlternative: Use local state, parent-to-child props, explicit dependencies, or pub/sub.
migrationApproach: Inject shared stores through register dependencies and document the contract.

whyProblematic: Deep mutable structures make updates and rollback difficult.
correctAlternative: Keep state shallow when possible and replace arrays or objects intentionally.
migrationApproach: Extract child components and pass only needed state.

whyProblematic: Directive expressions and view() may run on each render and should be deterministic.
correctAlternative: Run effects in main(), event handlers, effect(), or explicit async functions.
migrationApproach: Move network calls, timers, and mutations out of render expressions.

whyProblematic: Listeners and external instances may leak after custom element disconnect.
correctAlternative: Create external resources in main() and clean them in unmount().
migrationApproach: Wrap setup and teardown around Jails lifecycle helpers.

whyProblematic: Large shape changes make morphing less predictable and examples harder to learn from.
correctAlternative: Keep stable containers and conditionally render inner sections.
migrationApproach: Introduce stable wrapper elements and move conditions below them.

whyProblematic: It hides a relationship already represented by the DOM tree.
correctAlternative: Use parent state flow for parent-to-child and emit() for child-to-parent.
migrationApproach: Replace topic names with DOM custom events when components share a tree.

whyProblematic: html-model is parsed with new Function and must not contain user input.
correctAlternative: Use safe server serialization or data attributes for scalar values.
migrationApproach: Move untrusted content into text nodes or fetch it after mount.
